audit_metadata.dataset_scope: OPS02_v1.0.1_FROZEN (Specific to the frozen OPS-02 dataset; not a generalized identity for future datasets)

authoritative_independence_contract.governing_rule: GOV-RULE-077 (Mission Datatake and Orbital Clustering Invariant)
authoritative_independence_contract.formal_statement: Independence is defined by the parent acquisition cluster (cluster_id). In the frozen OPS-02 dataset, cluster_id is bijectively mapped to mission_data_take_id, so the two identifiers represent the exact same 64 parent acquisition units.
authoritative_independence_contract.scientific_rationale: Sentinel-1 continuously acquires data along an orbital pass during a single mission datatake. Slices along the same pass share orbit, look angle geometry, calibration state, and regional weather. Grouping by datatake cluster guarantees physical independence across partition boundaries.

bijection_mathematical_proof.scope: All 212 samples in ops02_physical_dataset_manifest_v1.json and 64 clusters in ops02_parent_cluster_manifest_v1.json
bijection_mathematical_proof.cross_manifest_consistency: 100% agreement between physical manifest and cluster manifest

c22b_computational_dependency_audit.parent_cluster_accounting: Dynamic evaluation from manifest s['cluster_id'] over 40 TRAIN clusters
c22b_computational_dependency_audit.sampler_strategy: Candidate F Hybrid (72 draws/epoch, replacement=True, seed=42)

historical_impact_and_provenance_audit.former_23_figure_provenance: Typographical error in initial narrative text draft of LL-EXP07-019 in ocean_sentinel_lessons_learned_v1.json. Automated test test_lesson_019_parent_datatake_accounting always derived and asserted 40 datatakes.
historical_impact_and_provenance_audit.calibrated_impact_statement: The physical dataset membership, partition membership, pixel/mask content, canonical loss-weight vector, and relevant computational configurations were not changed by the correction of the erroneous '23' narrative figure. No historical computational path using the value 23 was identified.
historical_impact_and_provenance_audit.distinction_between_historical_and_curre: Historical documents retain their original text with documented errata; current source-of-truth protocols and learning registers are repaired to reflect the authoritative 40 TRAIN clusters (64 total).

readiness_decision.justification: All small uncertainties are resolved: cluster_id <-> mission_data_take_id is mathematically proven bijective across all partitions of the frozen OPS-02 dataset; actual C22-B computational dependencies contain zero stale independence parameters; all current source-of-truth documents agree on 40 TRAIN clusters (64 total); model initial states match bitwise; and all safety quarantine boundaries remain 100% intact.
